Description: Switch and show anything on your MQTT broker.
Name: Home Assistant Controller

Localization.Lamps in Home Assistant in the cover col: Lamps in Home Assistant in the cover colour of what plays on the deck; off brings them back as they were.
Localization.Switch a light or plug on and off, and s: Switch a light or plug on and off, and see its state.

pi.switch_help: Press: switch on or off. The key shows the state the device reports.
pi.state_topic_hint: Where the device reports its state. Type to search all topics on the MQTT broker.
pi.field_placeholder: Field in the JSON, e.g. state
pi.label: Name
pi.label_placeholder: Empty: the name from Home Assistant
pi.command_topic_hint: Where commands go, if not to the state topic (zigbee2mqtt: …/set).
pi.template_hint: {value} becomes the value for on or off. Empty: the value alone.
pi.availability_topic_hint: The key is greyed out while this topic says offline.
pi.retain_hint: The broker keeps the command for new subscribers. Usually off.
pi.ha_address_hint: A host alone means http://host:8123. Also https://.
pi.ha_found_none: Nothing found. The search often fails over a VPN: type the address instead.
pi.ha_token_hint: In Home Assistant: Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens → Create token.
pi.ha_state_denied: Token refused: create a new token
pi.ha_state_invalid: That is not a Home Assistant address
pi.broker_address_hint: A host alone means mqtt://host:1883. Also mqtts://, ws:// and wss://.
pi.allow_self_signed_hint: Only for mqtts:// or wss:// with your own certificate.
pi.ha_device_show: Show Stream Deck in Home Assistant
pi.ha_device_hint: With an MQTT broker, the device “HA-C on <PC>” appears with the sensor “Cover colour” (the active player's colour), “Stream Deck” (online or not) and the switch “Cover light” (switches the Cover Light keys). Without a broker only sensor.ha_c_cover_color, until Home Assistant restarts. Switching off removes it all again.
pi.cover_light_help: Press: the lamps light up in the cover's colour and change with every track. Press again: the lamps go back to how they were.
pi.no_lamps: No colour lamps found in Home Assistant.
pi.state_denied: Access denied: check user name and password
pi.state_invalid: That is not an MQTT broker address
pi.value_help: Shows the value the device reports, coloured by your colour ranges.
pi.value_topic_hint: Where the device reports the value. Type to search all topics on the MQTT broker.
pi.auto_value_hint: Empty: ON/OFF, true/false, 1/0 and open/closed are recognised, and the key answers in the same words.
pi.press_state_topic_hint: E.g. the plug whose power the key shows. Framed on the key while on.
pi.send_payload_hint: Sent as it is on every press.
pi.value_line_hint: Shown under the icon, e.g. the power of the plug.
pi.value_colors_hint: While on, the icon takes the colour of the range the value is in, e.g. red from 1000 W.
pi.publish_help: Press: runs the scene, script, button or automation; with MQTT, sends the payload. With a confirmation, the first press arms the key for 3 seconds.
pi.confirm_hint: Press twice: for a gate, an alarm, anything you don't want to trigger by accident.
pi.multi_help: Press: the next state of the list. The key shows the one the device reports. With Home Assistant: pick a select (e.g. a heating mode), its options become the states; remove the ones the key should skip.
pi.multi_topic_hint: Where the device reports its current value.
pi.multi_label_placeholder: Shown while the state is unknown
pi.multi_template_hint: {value} becomes the state's value. Empty: the value alone.
pi.slider_help: Rotate: set the value · Push or tap: what you choose below (e.g. switch the light on and off).
pi.slider_topic_hint: Where the device reports the value the dial sets (brightness, setpoint).
pi.slider_template_hint: {value} becomes the number, e.g. {"brightness":{value}}. Empty: the number alone.
pi.step_hint: How much one click of the dial changes the value, e.g. 0.5 for a thermostat.
pi.actual_hint: E.g. the room temperature: the arc shows it, a marker the setpoint.
pi.push_state_topic_hint: E.g. the lamp's on/off state. While it is off, the dial is dimmed and shows “Off”.
pi.percent_hint: Devices count differently (zigbee2mqtt 0–254, Homematic 0–255, others 0–100). Enter the device's range as minimum and maximum; the dial shows 0–100 %.
pi.listening: Listening: switch the device now, by hand or in its app … {n} s
pi.heard_nothing: Nothing changed. Try again and switch the device while listening.
pi.heard: Changed while listening; the most likely first:
pi.test_hint: Switches the device once and checks that it answers.
pi.test_no_topic: Choose a state or command topic first.
pi.test_offline: Not connected to the MQTT broker.
pi.device_hint: From Home Assistant (by area) and your broker's MQTT discovery. Picking one fills in everything below.
pi.by_hand_sub: Enter state and command topics yourself
pi.attribute_hint: What the key shows: the state or an attribute, e.g. a thermostat's current_temperature. Brightness shows in %.
pi.second_line_hint: A second, smaller value under the first, e.g. the humidity under the temperature.
pi.value_line_ha_hint: Shown under the icon, e.g. the light's brightness or the plug's power (another entity).
pi.slider_ha_hint: Range, step and unit come from Home Assistant: lights, fans and covers in % (push switches them on and off), a thermostat with its setpoint and the room temperature on the arc (push changes its mode, e.g. auto → heat → off), numbers with their own range. A step of your own, e.g. 1, replaces HA's.
pi.set_up_hint: Not set up yet: pick a device above, or set the key up here (e.g. with an MQTT topic).
pi.press_entity_hint: Switch: a light, plug, lock … (the frame shows whether it is on). Trigger: a scene, script, button or automation.
pi.color_caption_hint: Off: white, readable on every colour. On: in the key's colour (harder to read with dark colours).
pi.effect_color_hint: A lamp gives its colour, a text helper e.g. “#FF8800”, “255,136,0” or “red”; optionally from an attribute. “none” = no colour from HA.
pi.effect_number_hint: The value between From and To (empty: the helper's range, else 0–100) sets the effect's speed or density. Values from HA apply to the whole Panorama, also across other plugins' dials; turning an effect dial counts until the value in HA changes.
pi.effect_level_hint: The value divided by the maximum moves the effect (speed, density) as music does: e.g. power 0–2000 W.

Localization.Show a value with its unit, e.g. a tempe: Show a value with its unit, e.g. a temperature or power, as text or on a half-circle gauge.
Localization.Run something once: a scene, script, but: Run something once: a scene, script, button or automation, or an MQTT message (e.g. opening a gate).
Localization.Step through several values, e.g. fan of: Step through several values, e.g. fan off, 1, 2, 3, and see the current one.
Localization.Set a value with a dial: brightness, a t: Set a value with a dial: brightness, a thermostat's setpoint, a blind. Push switches on and off.
